thread.title: Elon Musk spars with Fortnite on Twitter after joking about buying the video game

author: morningstar.com
title: Elon Musk spars with Fortnite on Twitter after joking about buying the video game
text:
By Jacob Passy
The Tesla CEO tweeted out a doctored screenshot of a MarketWatch story claiming he had deleted the video game
The latest target of Tesla (TSLA) CEO Elon Musk's ire? The video game Fortnite.
In a post on Twitter, Musk jokingly claimed (https://twitter.com/elonmusk/status/1053390822991790083) on Friday to have purchased and then deleted the popular online video game, saying it "had to been (sic) done." The tweet included an image that appears to be an edited screenshot of a MarketWatch article.
(https://twitter.com/elonmusk/status/1053390822991790083)
Fortnite's official Twitter(TWTR) account responded by poking fun (https://twitter.com/FortniteGame/status/1053451758930923521) at the fact that it will take a decade for Musk's SpaceX to build its first base on Mars. Musk replied, saying, "Reality is hard." (https://twitter.com/elonmusk/status/1053469867452452864)
Fortnite is an online video game that was first released in 2017 and can be played on many devices, including Windows computers (MSFT), Android (GOOGL) and Apple (AAPL) mobile devices, the Nintendo Switch (7974.TO), the Xbox One and the PlayStation 4 (6758.TO). The Battle Royale mode of the game had 125 million players (https://www.theverge.com/2018/6/12/17456814/fortnite-battle-royale-epic-games-125-million-players-first-year-e3-2018)as of June.
(https://twitter.com/FortniteGame/status/1053451758930923521)
More:Here's how much Tesla lost in market cap now that Musk's SEC settlement is approved (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/heres-how-much-tesla-lost-in-market-cap-now-that-musks-sec-settlement-is-approved-2018-10-16)
Musk's post also elicited a slew of retorts from the Tesla and Fortnite fans alike. An Elon Musk parody account called Bored Elon Musk tweeted that Musk should "stay in [his] lane." (Musk, in a reply, suggested that he may be the creator of the parody account (https://twitter.com/elonmusk/status/1053503899166855169).)
Others joked that Musk should buy T-Series (https://twitter.com/Almilol_56/status/1053668398826172418), the Indian music record label that runs a YouTube channel with the second largest number of subscribers behind video game commentator PewDiePie. Another Twitter user suggested (https://twitter.com/NCBirbhan/status/1053400098582028288) that Musk "buy and delete" Ford (F) instead.
(https://twitter.com/BoredElonMusk/status/1053394306680074240)
Musk engaged with many of the people who commented on the tweet, including one person who took issue with his implication (https://twitter.com/elonmusk/status/1053432175696048130) that Fortnite players don't have social lives. The game is wildly popular with young men -- much to the dismay of some of their parents, who are sometimes left to foot the bill (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/why-its-so-easy-to-dig-yourself-into-a-financial-hole-with-games-like-fortnite-2018-05-10) when players buy extras while they're playing.
See: SEC settlement forces Tesla to give Elon Musk adult supervision (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/sec-settlement-forces-tesla-to-find-elon-musk-some-adult-supervision-2018-09-29)
In late September, Musk and Tesla agreed to a $40 million settlement (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/elon-musk-settlement-with-sec-costs-him-tesla-chairmanship-and-20-million-fine-2018-09-29) with the Securities and Exchange Commission over fraud charges related to Musk's tweets earlier this year in which he claimed to be exploring taking the automaker private.
The settlement also forced Tesla to remove Musk as chairman of the board and required the company to set up guidelines and oversight (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/sec-settlement-forces-tesla-to-find-elon-musk-some-adult-supervision-2018-09-29) regarding Musk's social media presence.
-Jacob Passy; 20-18 1500ET
